[נוּשׁ verb be sick, si vera lectio (= I. אנשׁ according to Thes who compare Syriac ); —

Qal Imperfect 1 singular וָָֽאָנוּשָׁה Ps 69:21, but read perhaps [מַכַּת נַפְשִׁי] וַאֲנוּשָׁה ׅ || (חֶרְפָּה שָׁ֑בְרָה לִבִּי, Bi Checritical note, compare ᵐ5, see I.אנשׁ or (< קַוֹּה) וְאָנוּשׁ הוּא קַוֵּה (with different word-division), WeirAcad. 1870, 257 (who compare Jer 17:9; Jer 8:15).
